subject.title: Gemini models output inline buttons as raw JSON text instead of using tool format

question: Should OpenClaw accept a constrained raw bracketed JSON fallback for Gemini final replies, or require inline buttons to be emitted only through typed message-tool and presentation fields?
rationale: The current source proves the structured-only gap, but raw final-text parsing expands the model-visible message contract and affects transcript plus Telegram presentation behavior.

options.title: Accept Narrow Raw Fallback
options.body: Allow constrained extraction only if the linked PR or replacement is rebased, transcript-safe, and backed by redacted live Gemini/Telegram proof.

options.title: Retarget To Typed Routing
options.body: Reject raw final-text parsing and focus the fix on provider prompting or tool-routing so buttons use the existing structured contract.

options.title: Hold For Live Repro First
options.body: Keep the issue open but pause implementation acceptance until a maintainer or reporter supplies live Gemini/Telegram reproduction evidence.

recommendation.title: Accept Narrow Raw Fallback
recommendation.body: Allow constrained extraction only if the linked PR or replacement is rebased, transcript-safe, and backed by redacted live Gemini/Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The open candidate PR requests `steipete` review and the decision crosses typed presentation, Telegram controls, and final-reply product behavior.
